blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Local fuel prices may drop next week, September 29, as optimism grows for a supply increase and a potential renewal of peace talks between the United States and Iran. In an advisory on Friday, Jetti Petroleum president Leo Bellas said P7 may slash diesel to P7.50 per liter. Gasoline prices may also dip by 50 centavos to P1 per liter.
